description: This file defines a Java interface named LoanCOBCatchUpService that provides methods related to loan COb catch-up processes, such as unlocking hard-locked loans, retrieving the oldest COB processed loan, executing catch-up, and checking if catch-up is running.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpService
classes.description: An interface defining services related to loan COB catch-up operations.

methods.name: getOldestCOBProcessedLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest loan processed in COB.

methods.name: executeLoanCOBCatchUp
methods.description: Executes the COB catch-up process for loans.

methods.name: isCatchUpRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the COB catch-up process is currently running.
